name: Pearl & Rowe
oneLiner: A calm dental studio — every step explained before it begins, and nothing begins until you nod.
paletteSeed: warm linen paper, oak-brown ink (never black), sage as the quiet clinical green, terracotta as the act colour, morning cream light — no teal, no clinical white; softness carried by arches, linen texture, and unhurried spacing
typeDirection: Literata (warm bookish serif, display + text, opsz at work) + Atkinson Hyperlegible (humanist sans built by the Braille Institute for legibility — the care register made typographic; chart numerals tabular) — both OFL, vendored
motionBudget: calm only: the check-up pass moves tooth to tooth along the FDI chart with scroll while the record fills with quiet marks, arches soft-reveal their scenes, record chips ease in, the consent line underlines itself once; reduced-motion serves the completed chart and static arches; no-JS = the full chart, legend, and every record
